frame.units: width and center_x in Qud cell-width units; height and center_z in world units. Shared1.2x1.2world frame, no per-facing resize.

views.south: Selected curled south swimming-plane catfish, head toward south; dorsal/lateral/tail fins keep their identities.
views.east: Whole selected animal turns east under actual live fish-pawn map camera; no independent head/fin turn.
views.north: Whole selected animal turns north in swimming plane; source curl and fin count unchanged.
views.west: Supported mirror of east, whole geometry and tint ownership together.

pivot: Fixed384,384 trunk/swim pivot, not human ground feet. Both color planes share identical physical frame and eventual native transform.
policy: Observed worn/held list is empty. Default Face Glowfish_Bite remains native natural attack behavior, not a carried object or clothing. No fins/head treated as independent articulated renderer bones.
